meta.parties: Nadarajah v. H. Don Carolis & Sons, Ltd

rules.statement: This court may grant relief under section 756 of the Civil Procedure Code, even if formal notice was not given as required, if the Supreme Court deems it just and the respondent has not been materially prejudiced.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to us that this case is a fit one in which relief should be granted under the amendment I have quoted above."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 756 of the Civil Procedure Code, amended by section 2 of Ordinance No. 42 of 1921.
